title: Q3 Rapid Iteration Roadmap: Dedicated Adaptive Pools & Autoscale Experimentation
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Objective: Deliver a compact, experiment-driven quarterly roadmap that (1) validates adaptive dedicated pool sizing for bursty workloads, (2) proves autoscale heuristics that respect SLOs and cost corridors, and (3) captures operational playbooks for fast rollback. We will run three parallel experiments across Dedicated pools: predictive prewarm, hedged reservoir with rapid fallback, and aggressive burst with soft-SLA degradation. The emphasis is on tight learning cycles (1–2 week experiments), instrumentation for per-route unit economics, and slice-based rollouts tied to OKR metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment framework deployed to staging with synthetic load generator and canary routes
Per-route token-level cost and latency telemetry available in Console for all test runs
Clear success/failure signal definitions for each experiment and documented rollback runbooks
Three experiments executed with at least one validated autoscale heuristic ready for pilot on select customers

rollout_plan: 1) Run 2-week experiments in staging using canary routes. 2) Validate SLO, cost uplift, and failure modes. 3) Promote winning heuristic to limited pilot (5 customers) with feature flags and SLA guardrails. 4) Iterate two cycles, then propose full pilot expansion tied to Q3 OKR signoff.
metrics: OKR-1: Reduce 99th pct latency regression during bursts to <= +10% relative to baseline
OKR-2: Keep per-token cost uplift for burst coverage < 12% for pilot workloads
OKR-3: Demonstrate automated rollback within 5 minutes for failed heuristics
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Prewarm misattributes benefits to KV cache. Mitigation: Isolate cache-disabled control group and run A/B.
Risk: Hedging increases steady-state cost. Mitigation: Add time-window tuning and cost alarms per pool; require ROI signoff for production expansion.
Risk: Customer-facing regressions during pilot. Mitigation: Start with low-risk customers, enable rapid fallback to hosted model variants, and maintain a 2-hour on-call rota during pilot.
Risk: Insufficient telemetry coverage. Mitigation: Ship minimal token-level cost emitter before experiments and block on data availability.
